# Earth Networks

> > Earth Networks provides real-time weather intelligence, lightning detection, and meteorological data through the Sferic platform for enterprise safety and decision-making.

Earth Networks operates the world's largest weather observation network, delivering critical weather data and alerts through products like Sferic Maps and the Sferic Weather API. The platform serves organizations across sports, aviation, utilities, and other industries requiring real-time weather intelligence for safety and operational decisions.

## Key Topics

- Sferic Weather API
- Sferic Maps
- Real-time weather data
- Lightning detection and tracking
- Weather forecasting
- Meteorological data
- Weather safety alerts
- Athlete and fan safety
- Enterprise weather intelligence
- Weather analytics
- Storm tracking
- API authentication
- Sports weather safety

## API & Developer Resources

- [Sferic Weather Data Forecasting API](https://developer.earthnetworks.com/): Sferic Weather API for real-time weather, lightning & meteorological data

## Case Studies & Applications

- [Major League Soccer Protects Players and Fans](https://www.earthnetworks.com/?sferic_stories=major-league-soccer-protects-players-and-fans-with-real-time-weather-intelligence): MLS case study using Sferic Maps for real-time weather & player safety
